clips.title: The story
paras: A washed-up bottle found along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale holds an urgent plea for rescue. Its author claims to be held prisoner by a great beast on an isolated island in the South Seas.

Inside a glass container half-buried in the sand lies a neatly penned note asking for immediate assistance. The captive reports being trapped on a foreign island beneath thick jungle canopies, held by a great Skymane. Glimpses through the trees offer only faint landmarks: the coast of Wild Shore lies visible to the northwest, while large sailing vessels drift to the southwest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:
To any that can aid me-
Please, my need for help is dire. A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.
The stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild Shore to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.
I beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Have you come to free me?
